place: Sonamarg Meadow of Gold and Thajiwas Glacier
text: Sonamarg Meadow of Gold and Thajiwas Glacier is a celebrated destination in Ganderbal, Jammu and Kashmir, renowned for its hill stations, nature, glaciers. Located in the historic and scenic region of Jammu and Kashmir, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Jammu and Kashmir. The best time to plan a visit is generally March to June (pleasant summer flowers) and September to November (crisp autumn views). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
